name: AI Agent Team
headline: AI Agent Team - Boost Your Development Efficiency
short_description: The AI Agent Team provides a 24/7 professional development team including product managers, front-end and back-end developers, and DevOps engineers. With one-click installation and support for both Chinese and English commands, it significantly enhances development efficiency.
author: peterfei

sections.overview:
AI Agent Team assembles a complete professional development team as AI agents—including product managers, frontend developers, backend developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and tech leads—available 24/7 for your projects. The system includes Thread Manager, a persistent memory system that uses semantic search and automatic Git integration to help AI agents maintain context across long-running tasks and manage multiple parallel development threads. Installation takes three steps and works with Claude Code and other AI code editors. It solves the problem of losing context when Claude sessions restart and enables true multi-task project management by allowing developers to switch between threads while preserving complete conversation history and work state.
Streamlining software development processes
Enhancing team collaboration
Automating code deployment
Improving project management efficiency
sections.usage:
```
Act as my AI Agent Team. I need to integrate Productiv's finance solution into our existing SaaS platform. Assign roles to your team members: one product manager, one front-end developer, one back-end developer, and one DevOps engineer. Provide a high-level plan for the integration, including key milestones and estimated timelines. Use both Chinese and English for communication as needed.
```
Copy

```
AI Agent Team Integration Plan for Productiv Finance Solution

Product Manager (PM):
- Define integration scope and success metrics
- Coordinate cross-functional alignment
- Timeline: Ongoing throughout project

Front-End Developer (FED):
1. Week 1-2: Implement Productiv UI components
   - Create mockups for approval
   - Develop responsive dashboard elements
2. Week 3: Integrate with back-end APIs
3. Week 4: Test and optimize user experience

Back-End Developer (BED):
1. Week 1: Set up Productiv API connections
2. Week 2: Develop data synchronization logic
3. Week 3: Implement security protocols
4. Week 4: Performance testing and optimization

DevOps Engineer (DOE):
1. Week 1: Set up CI/CD pipeline
2. Week 2: Configure monitoring and logging
3. Week 3: Prepare deployment strategy
4. Week 4: Execute phased rollout

Key Milestones:
- Week 2: UI/UX approval
- Week 3: API integration complete
- Week 4: System testing begins
- Week 5: Staged deployment starts

Communication Plan:
- Daily standups in English
- Weekly progress reports in Chinese
- Critical issues escalated immediately

Risk Management:
- Regular backups of all integration code
- Rollback plan for each deployment phase
- Cross-team knowledge sharing sessions

Project Timeline:
- Total duration: 5 weeks
- Buffer time: 1 week
- Contingency plan: 2 weeks

Note: All timelines are estimates and may vary based on actual implementation challenges.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
